intendedCoverage: Real observed compact stars against a textured dark background in an authored raster input
Point/edge preservation during manual denoise/detail and ordinary enlargement
Preexisting telescope optical reflections around bright points
limitations: This is a published processed telescope U-band JPEG, not Sony RAW, calibrated sensor data or a clean/noisy pair.
The native published image is only 651 × 651 pixels; it does not establish full-size astrophotography performance.
The bright central cross is described by ESO as an optical reflection, not evidence of a new sharpening artifact.
No calibrated radiometry, star photometry, true sky color, physical HDR or ground-truth denoising claim follows from these pixels.
Generated crops/filter/resizing results must retain clear visible AURA credit, active source/license links and descriptions of changes.
The fixture is for isolated project testing, never an automatic application demo/import.
